title: Problem Overview
content:
**Erdős Problem #801: Dense Subgraphs in Graphs with Bounded Independence**

If G has n vertices and α(G) ≤ √n, then some set of ≤ √n vertices contains ≫ √n log n edges.

**Answer:** YES (Alon, 1996)

Graphs with small independence number must have locally dense regions.
mathContext: This captures a local-global phenomenon: a global constraint (bounded independence) implies local structure (dense subset).

title: Independence Number α(G)
content:
**α(G) = max{|S| : S is an independent set in G}**

An independent set has no edges between its vertices. The problem constrains α(G) ≤ √n.

title: Induced Edges
content:
**e(S) = number of edges in the subgraph induced by S**

Count edges with both endpoints in S. The problem asks for S with |S| ≤ √n but e(S) ≫ √n log n.

title: Erdos801Statement
content:
**Main Statement:**

∃ c > 0 such that for all n ≥ 2, for all G with n vertices:

If α(G) ≤ √n, then ∃ S with |S| ≤ √n and e(S) ≥ c · √n · log n

title: Alon's Theorem (1996)
content:
**alon_1996** axiomatizes Alon's proof that Erdos801Statement holds. The theorem erdos_801_solved directly references this axiom.

Proved using probabilistic methods and concentration inequalities.

title: Log Factor is Necessary
content: **log_factor_necessary** formalizes that the √n log n bound is tight: for any constant C, there exist graphs with α(G) ≤ √n where every ≤ √n vertex set has at most C · √n · log n induced edges. The bound cannot be asymptotically improved.

title: Vertex Set Size Optimal
content: **vertex_set_size_optimal** formalizes that the set size √n cannot be reduced: for any ε < 1, eventually there exist graphs where sets of size ε√n have fewer than √n induced edges.

title: erdos_801_summary
content:
**erdos_801_summary** combines two results:
1. **alon_1996** — Erdős Problem #801 is solved: bounded independence forces dense local subsets
2. **log_factor_necessary** — the √n log n edge count is tight up to constants

Proved by exact ⟨alon_1996, log_factor_necessary⟩.
